limitations: Historical synthetic/model calibration only; no new scientific adjudication or nature-level inference.

original_claim.claim: The shifted-field chance-alignment estimator R = N_shift/N_real, evaluated on the nonuniform-footprint synthetic population with known injected field-star contamination fractions (5%, 10%, 20%) and RA-wrap/polar field placements, recovers each injected fraction within the predeclared tolerance (+/-0.05 absolute at 5%, +/-25% relative at 10% and 20%).
original_claim.kill: R_chance falls outside the predeclared tolerance band for any injected-contamination arm or any field placement (equatorial baseline, RA-wrap, polar).
original_claim.evidence: ORB-11222's cataloged frozen run at Orrery 28dd5c72 passes the 5% arms but under-recovers every planted 10%/20% rate; this failed control is unresolved calibration evidence, not a gravity claim. ORB-11241 owns diagnosis.

diagnostic_control.evidence: Protocol step 4 asks for planted pairs that are explicitly 'not physical pairs'; the fixture planted newtonian_mock_pairs output through the true-pair path, giving both components one shared distance and Keplerian relative PM. The genuine chance-alignment content of the selected sample is 0.0000 (R3-10) and 0.0009 (R3-20), and the estimator returned within 0.0010 of that in every arm. It was scored against contamination that was never injected, in a denominator it does not use.
diagnostic_control.locus: population generator (Orrery fixture) plus the gate's denominator; Astrolabe not implicated
diagnostic_control.positive_control: With genuine chance alignments present the estimator tracks them: label truth 0.0000 -> 0.0777 across the field-PM ladder, estimate 0.0000 -> 0.1630, monotone and shift-insensitive.
